title: Social Bias in Popular Question-Answering Benchmarks
findings: The analysis of religious entities in benchmark datasets revealed a significant representational bias. Christianity and its denominations (e.g., Catholicism) are the most frequently represented religions, ranking in the top-3 for 14 out of 15 analyzed benchmarks. Islam and Judaism appear in the top-3 for a smaller subset of benchmarks, while other major world religions like Buddhism and Hinduism are significantly less represented.
